That's it — thank you, both fields are there now and they work. I opened Edit, reworded the description to "My concise guide to JavaScript," took the `?utm_source=newsletter` junk off the end of the address, and saved. The card came back with the new description and the cleaned-up address, and everything else — the title, my label, the To read status — stayed exactly as it was. That's exactly the "fix up a bookmark" screen I was hoping for.

On your question about showing the full address during normal use: no, I don't think I'd want that long web address on every card all the time. It's helpful right now for checking this edit, but day to day it's just clutter — I'd rather each card stay clean and readable, showing the short source like "developer.mozilla.org" so I can tell at a glance where it's from. The full address is really only something I need when I'm editing or when I actually click through to the page. So I'd keep the full thing tucked into the edit panel like you've got it, and leave the cards showing just the short source.

With that, this editing flow is right.
